items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And we came here to New York with Zack and played Savoy.

ctx.x: Well yeah -- in the Midwest, yeah. And Jack White (PHONETIC) -- I joined him. And we came here to New York with Zack and played Savoy. And that's where I made my first record that they released.
But I never got any -- what do they call -- no mentions on it. But I sang it and it was with Louis ________.
